description: Graphs a maintainer has checked end to end against the map and found correct. Each entry pins the graph it was checked against (graph_sha256 = maps_geo.verified.graph_sha256 of its vertex codes and edges); the export fails if a build changes a verified graph, so re-check it and update the entry. Written by hand; nothing writes it automatically.

graphs.note: All 33 departments and 73 borders checked by the maintainer, after adding the Boyacá-Meta border that every geometry source collapses to a quadripoint

repinned.why: v0.2 relabels Bogota from NE's CO-CUN:Bogota to its ISO code CO-DC (wg.units rule); the vertices and the 73 borders are otherwise identical to the verified graph
